summary: ```markdown # CLO Techniques Mini Class - Production of Elastic Bands (Real Reverse Fold) ## Introduction Hello everyone! In addition to the three-layer structure method mentioned earlier, the loose belt can also be used to make real counterfeits of the version. ## Arranging the Model Next, let's open the arrangement points on the model first. 1. **Arrange the Waist Version**: - Position the waist version on the model. - Adjust the frame arrangement of the version in the attribute editor. 2. **Closing Arrangement Points**: - After arranging in the appropriate position, close the arrangement points on the model. ## Sewing Process 1. **Sewing the Waist and Skirt Together**: - Sew the waist and skirt together. 2. **Basic Line on the Waist Version**: - The basic line on the waist version is listed as the internal line. - Add the elastic band version and waist version. - Add the sewing line. 3. **Incorporating the Elastic Band Version**: - Add the elastic band version to the inside of the waist version. ## Folding and Hooking 1. **Folding the Waist Version**: - Choose to fold the arrangement at the 3D window and fold the waist version back. - Continue to hook the other side of the internal line. 2. **Filling in the Sewing Line**: - Fill in the sewing line to ensure secure attachment. ## Setting Layer Tool To make the elastic band version remain inside the waist version, we can use the setting layer tool. - **Positioning the Elastic Band Version**: - Let the elastic band version be on the inside of the reverse waist version. - This is equivalent to the elastic band version remaining on the outside of the opposite side of the waist version. - **Understanding the Setting Layer**: - Here is the relationship between the setting layer and the opposite side of the version. - You can check the previous video for more details. - The setting layer is useful for fully understanding the use of the setting layer tool. ## Final Steps 1. **Fixing the Waist Version**: - The waist version is equivalent to fixed and immobilized. - Click on the elastic band version first, then click on the waist version. - Change the plus button to the minus button to set the elastic band version on the opposite side of the waist version. 2. **Simulation Check**: - Open the simulation; you can see that the waist version is very stable. - It is difficult to reach "aabo" because of occupations. 3. **Improving Quality**: - The waist version is "냄 béning". - Choose back juice for the waist version to improve the quality. 4. **Folding Adjustments**: - Make the folding of the elastic band waist more細 (detailed). - To increase the quality of the uniform clothing, make the folding of the elastic band waist stand higher. - Attach at the waist of the waistourd. ## Conclusion So, the proper waist band is already made. Successfully misunderstood this process for a better wind-holding video. ```
